|game_text='''0 side - Imperial Occupation (V)'''

Deploy Hoth system, Ice Plains, and Main Power Generators (Light Side). May deploy Imperial Decree. For remainder of game, AT-ATs are deploy -1. You may not deploy Colo Claw Fish. Revolution is canceled. While this side up, AT-ATs may move for free. Rebels are deploy -1 to Hoth sites. Opponent loses no Force to You May Start Your Landing. During your control phase, may take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle one AT-AT Cannon, Electro-Rangefinder, Death Squadron, a (Hoth) AT-AT, or a (Hoth) Epic Event. Flip this card if Main Power Generators 'blown away.'

'''7 side - Imperial Control (V)'''

While this side up, Rebel Base Occupation is canceled. Walker Garrison is an Out Of Play Interrupt and Immune to Sense. Rebels are deploy +1 to Hoth sites. Your total battle destiny at Hoth system is +1 for each Imperial there. Unless opponent controls a Hoth location, your Force drain bonuses may not be canceled. Once per turn, when you deploy an AT-AT, may take any one card (except an Interrupt or vehicle) from Lost Pile into hand. During your deploy phase, may deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle a marker site.
|game_text_note=Game text transcribed from VirtualCards4.pdf slip (IA Wayback). Official text as of December 4, 2006. Cover also defines maintenance-cost and grabber icons. Uniqueness bullet shown as (*). Other sheet icons (side affiliation, planet/site, etc.) named from the printed slip where readable.
